system.description: You never received the ritual of blooding from your sire or other warriors, and your training has stalled. You may not progress beyond the second level of Valeren until you receive the ritual, and you are two Traits down on any Social roll against a blooded Salubri. Only warrior Salubri may take this Flaw.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
